purpose: Define DWH data origin, local/remote classification and input scope at the point where data enters the originating instance.

topics.name: DWH Origin and Scope
topics.purpose: Define DWH data origin, local/remote classification and input scope at the point where data enters the originating instance.

semantics.origin_rule: Every governed DWH datum has an explicit origin instance/identity context.
semantics.classification_rule: Local and remote DWH semantics remain distinct from AccessCore authorization.
semantics.scope_rule: Input scope is applied at the data origin before remote propagation.
semantics.identity_rule: Origin identity is preserved through remote transport where required.
semantics.schema_rule: Input is validated/classified against the origin-side declared schema/binding.
semantics.authority_rule: DWH classification/scope does not itself grant read/write rights.

invariants.rule: DWH data movement preserves explicit origin identity, schema, scope and remote authority boundaries; transport connectivity never becomes data authority.

hard_gates.condition: input scope applied only after remote receipt
DWH scope treated as AccessCore permission

references.purpose: DWH scope remains orthogonal to authorization.

prose.summary: Define DWH data origin, local/remote classification and input scope at the point where data enters the originating instance.
